messages:
sam: FYI pushed PR #8241 that changes the tiling/shard placement logic for multi-GPU infer. Needs architecture signoff before merge. RFC linked: https://redwood.example/rfcs/2026-tiling-shim

sam: short summary: reduces cross-GPU KV traffic by grouping contiguous KV ranges, should cut tail latency for long sequences. No model changes.

alex: Can you paste the perf numbers you saw in staging? curious about p50/p95/p99 and token throughput.

sam: Quick numbers from the perf run this morning (staging): p50 18ms (-10%), p95 65ms (-18%), p99 220ms (-12%), tokens/s +14% on a 8xA100 pool. Loads were synthetic but sequence mix matched prod eval set.

maria: Thanks. Two asks before I bless this: 1) attach the RFC URL in the PR body, 2) add a short rollback/canary plan. Also call out any SLO deltas.

sam: will add RFC to PR body now. SLO impact: no consumer-facing correctness changes; expected latency improvement. delta on 99th is -12% (improvement).

sam: suggested canary: 1hr, 5% traffic, monitor p99 and error-rate. Fallback: route traffic back to tiling=legacy. command to flip back is in the runbook: ```
# revert to legacy tiling
kubectl -n infra patch config runtime-tiling --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/tilingMode","value":"legacy"}]'
```

lina: We have a 2pm PST release slot today. If arch bless is in next 30m and tests pass, we can merge and queue the canary for 2:10pm.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #8241 (unit, integration, staging-e2e). Build: 1h ago.

maria: I'll skim the RFC and the rollout plan. One more thing: add a small smoke test that verifies request/response parity for the same prompt across old/new tiling. If that exists, include test name in PR.

sam: good call — adding smoke test (runtime/smoke/tiling_parity.test) to the PR now. updated PR body with RFC and rollback steps. pinging @maria for final signoff.

maria: ack, I'll look and post a short note. If parity test and canary plan look good, arch +1 and you can merge into the release slot.

sam: thanks :thumbsup: updating PR and will hold for your +1 before merge.
